description: A CMake module script ('FindNEXUS.cmake') that attempts to locate and configure the Broadcom Nexus library and its components, setting appropriate variables and target properties based on availability.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Searches for the header file 'nexus_config.h' within specified directories to determine the include path of Nexus.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Attempts to locate the Nexus library and additional libraries such as b_os, nexus_client, and nxclient.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes CMake modules, such as 'FindPackageHandleStandardArgs', to facilitate standard argument handling.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles validation of the package detection process, setting NEXUS_FOUND accordingly.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Configures properties of imported or created CMake targets, particularly the NEXUS::NEXUS alias target.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Defines an imported target for the Nexus library named 'NEXUS::NEXUS'.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Outputs status or error messages during the configuration process.
